list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies, as published 18 Nov 2026
sourcesNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles for PSN progress targets). Every guide is written for this entry from the official descriptions and is not yet checked in-game; where a place or trigger is not pinned down, the guide says so.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours — there is nothing extra to do. Work the roadmap in order: story, side stories, activities, collectibles, then the cleanup jobs. The last trophy you earn will almost always be 100% Completion, so plan for that grind at the end.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission — it introduces Lucia and Jason and the Leonida setting. It unlocks early and cannot be missed; just play the story. If you are following the roadmap, this is the first trophy you will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Story trophies pop as the chapters close, so there is no special trick — keep the main missions moving. The chapter ends on a story beat, so finish it before wandering off to side content.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Same rule as every chapter trophy: main missions only, in order. Chapter 2 is where the game's economy opens up, so pick up side activities as you pass them, but the trophy itself only needs the chapter done.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now the map is mostly open — resist the urge to 100% everything yet; the roadmap saves collectibles for stage 4, when you have the full toolkit. Finish the chapter's missions and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Clear any side stories you care about before the final mission, because a few trophies can only be earned while the story is still open (see the Missables page).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the story's last beat, and a one-shot moment: once the credits roll you cannot replay the finale from inside the same save. Before you start it, clear every other missable on the list (Catch Me If You Can, In The Beginning…, Actions Speak Louder) and any side story you still want. The exact finale trigger is not pinned down yet, so treat the pre-finale save as your point of no return and keep a manual save before it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. A story mission in the early chapters; play the main missions in order and it pops on completion. No special preparation — just follow the mission markers.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a story heist mission. Heists in this game reward preparation: stock ammo and armour before you start, and the mission itself is linear once it begins.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a story mission. Play it when it appears in the mission flow — it is unmissable as long as you keep doing main missions.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a story mission. The name is the mission's own title — follow the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a story mission at the airport. Expect a combat-heavy sequence; bring a full loadout before the mission starts.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a story mission late in the campaign. It is one of the last missions before the finale, so use it as your cue to finish the missables (see the Missables page) before the final mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own completion checklist: every story mission, side strand, activity, collectible set and challenge the game counts. This is the long grind and the usual last trophy before the platinum. Track it in the game's stats screen and work the roadmap stages in order; the collectibles and activities stages are where most of the percentage lives.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime the game counts as stunts. The fastest way is to chain stunt jumps off ramps and long drops in a fast car, and to repeat the same reliable jumps. PSN tracks the count to 250, so check your progress in the stats screen and stop grinding once it reads 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (250). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The game counts nine distinct activity types — racing, fishing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, meditation, drone racing, hunting and stunt challenges are the ones named across the trophy list. Play one of each; you do not need to win or finish them, just try them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (9). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the ranges; each needs a gold-medal score. Work through them range by range, and learn each weapon's recoil and the timing bonus — gold is about consistency, not speed. The range menu shows how many you have golded.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (42). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location hosts its own drone race; win each one. Drone handling is the skill here — practice the tight courses before racing for the win, and remember the win has to be at every location, not just 14 wins anywhere.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (14). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same one. Work through the race list across the map; street, off-road and boat races all count as long as each event is a different one. Keep a checklist of which events you have won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (20). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge, then out-fish him: watch the tension meter, reel in bursts, and let the line slacken when the fish runs. One win against Cal is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Arcades are scattered across Leonida; pick a short game, learn its pattern, and finish one run. Completion, not a high score, is what counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand runs through the story; do each of his missions as they appear, and the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Side strands are easy to leave half-done, so clear Andy's before the finale.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as Andy's strand: follow Kenton's missions to their end. If Kenton's missions stop appearing, check the map for his marker — strands sometimes wait for a story chapter to unlock the next one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand ends with a final mission of its own. Clear it before the story finale, since side strands can close off once the credits roll.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers hand out short mission chains marked on the map; finish 8 full strands. The count is 8 complete strands, not 8 missions — a strand only counts when its last mission is done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (8). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand, same rule: follow it to its final mission. Keep an eye on the map for Randy's marker between chapters.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand ends with a final mission. Finish it before the finale so no strand is left dangling.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points; sit and meditate at all 18. They are spread across the whole map, so this is a stage-4 collectible run — do it with the map open and tick each spot off as you go.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (18). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks you to hunt one specific animal — track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring the proof back. The animal is unique, so the hunt only counts for Bret's target.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida in packs and sets; complete any 3 full sets. Sets are the long tail of collecting — grab cards as you travel in stage 4 and check the collection screen to see which sets are one card short.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (3). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo and tagging activity: do it at 100 different spots. The fastest route is a road trip with the map open, hitting each marked location once — repeats at the same spot do not count.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (100). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game tracks a long list of small challenges — stunt, combat, driving and exploration feats. Fifty of them, any fifty, so pick the easy ones first and let the count build as you play. Check the challenges menu to see which are closest to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (50). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Alleys, tunnels and water all break pursuit; the trophy pops when the wanted level drops to zero with your partner still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row, keeping the same wanted level through all three — do not let it drop or spike between robberies. Plan a route with three close shops, keep the getaways short, and do not stop for anything in between.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (3). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles and the game logs each new one. Variety is the point — try everything: cars, bikes, boats, planes, trucks. The vehicle list in the stats screen shows what you have found.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (100). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, line up the shots, and do not waste the slowdown on one target.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (5). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a one-off moment at Vice City International Airport: leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned — the description's own words. It is flagged missable because the airport sequence is tied to a story moment and cannot be repeated once it passes. Do it the first time you are at VCIA with the chance in front of you, and keep a save from before the airport mission just in case. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet, so the guide names the moment, not a button press, until the community maps it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhinos are tanks — deal with them in combat, on foot or in a vehicle, and the trophy pops. Expect heavy armour: explosives and height beat a head-on fight.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Scout the store first, move when the staff are turned away, and leave before anyone raises the alarm — one detection voids the attempt, but you can try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape. Vaults are the big jobs: plan the entry, grab the cash, and lose the heat before the trophy counts the job — an escape that ends in a bust does not count.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (5). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop an armored truck, take its cargo, and get away clean. Trucks run set routes, so pick a quiet stretch of road and block it; the escape matters as much as the robbery.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map is split into 52 named areas; visit every one. This is a pure exploration trophy — drive the whole map in stage 4, and the area name popping on screen is your confirmation that it counted.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (52). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Nine gangs run illegal operations across Leonida; rob one operation per gang. Each gang's turf is marked by its presence, so work gang by gang and tick them off as you go.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (9). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet moment on Ocean Beach: order a cocktail and take in the view. It is flagged missable because it is tied to a specific early story beat — the chance comes once, early, and does not come back. Do it the first time the game offers the moment, and keep a save from before that scene. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet, so the guide names the moment, not a step-by-step, until the community maps it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom front — the game wants the classic smash-and-grab exit. Pick a showroom, build speed on the approach, and drive straight through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throw. Any completed game at that alley counts — the trophy is about showing up at the right lanes, not a perfect score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A partnership moment — the description is deliberately vague, and PSN hides this one until it is earned. Play the story with your partner and the moment will come; the guide will name it once the community has mapped the trigger.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: PSN tracks a count to 500 for this one — choices made across the game, for better or worse. It is flagged missable because some choices are one-time story decisions that cannot be revisited. Make the choices as they come, keep a save before the big decisions, and do not rush past dialogue options — the count builds across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (500). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is about the retry itself. Any challenge or mission attempt that fails once and succeeds on the next attempt can pop it; do not reload a save after a failure if you want this one.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — the game's odd, unexplained moments. These are the UFO-style encounters the series is known for; explore the weird corners of the map at night and the moment will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat, not a gun. Get up speed beside a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It is a slow total, so launder after every big job instead of letting the bills pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target ($250,000). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell. It adds up across the whole game, so buy as you go and check the stats screen for the running total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target ($100,000). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Eight garages are for sale across Leonida; buy them all. They are also useful — each one stores vehicles — so buy them as you can afford them and the trophy pops on the eighth.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (8). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register 10 vehicles you own or find. Register each one as you discover it and the count climbs to 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade · PSNProfiles — PSN progress target (10). Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
